newsitem.title: USA: Novo Nordisk diabetes NDA gets expedited review.
newsitem.headline: Novo Nordisk diabetes NDA gets expedited review.

text.p: Novo Nordisk A/S said Monday that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has granted expedited review status to its New Drug Application for repaglinide, an oral antidiabetic agent for treatment of Type 2 diabetes.

Priority review status means that, on the basis of its assessment of the potential therapeutic significance of repaglinide, the FDA has placed repaglinide on a shorter review schedule (six months), in contrast to a normal approval time of 12-18 months.
Repaglinide is the first in a new chemical class of orally administered drugs for the treatment of Type 2 diabetes designed to regulate blood glucose during meal time.
Novo Nordisk said it is different from other oral anti-diabetic agents in structure, mechanism of action and clearance.
According to the company, the drug's quick onset and short duration of action concentrates its effect around meal time, which is important to the treatment of Type 2 diabetes.
Repaglinide was developed in cooperation with the German pharmaceutical company Boehringer Ingelheim GmbH.
